params.name: steps
params.meaning: sampling steps; Turbo is distilled to 8 NFEs (diffusers num_inference_steps=9 = 8 DiT forwards)
params.interactions: Turbo: community 8-12, 'more steps rarely help'; 30+ wastes time. Union 2.x non-8steps files 'may require more inference steps' - use the *-8steps builds instead

params.name: cfg
params.meaning: classifier-free guidance; 1.0 skips the unconditional pass

official_reference_code.turbo: guidance_scale 0.0 ('Guidance should be 0 for the Turbo models')

params.interactions: cfg > 1 on Turbo burns/oversaturates and doubles the forward passes (community). Base: cfg_normalization in diffusers ('False for general stylism, True for realism') has no verified ComfyUI equivalent (CFGNorm equivalence NOT FOUND)

params.name: shift
params.meaning: flow timestep shift; ComfyUI's ZImage model config sets sampling_settings shift 3.0 and every template sets the node to 3
params.interactions: the node default is 1.73 (AuraFlow) - leaving it is a mis-setting; multiplier fixed 1.0

params.name: denoise
params.interactions: 0.15-0.25 subtle, 0.25-0.35 creative; > 0.35 'may introduce artifacts'; use a detailed caption to keep coherence

params.name: width / height
params.meaning: multiples of 16 (node step); Flux-type 16-ch latent, /8 spatial
params.interactions: community: 1024 native, 768/512 for drafts; control images over ~2500 px should be scaled (template's bypassed ImageScaleToMaxDimension lanczos 1024)

params.name: negative
params.meaning: Turbo: none (ConditioningZeroOut of the positive); base: a real negative, 'optional, but would be powerful when you want to remove some unwanted content'
params.interactions: on Turbo write exclusions positively ('no text, no watermark, no logos')

params.name: seed
params.interactions: fix the seed when iterating prompts; Turbo diversity across seeds is officially 'Low'

rules.message: Z-Image's Qwen3-4B encoder loads through CLIPLoader with type 'lumina2' (ZImage is a Lumina2-derived config) - every official template; any other type is unsupported
the Z-Image text encoder is qwen_3_4b (bf16 / fp8_mixed / fp4_mixed) from Comfy-Org/z_image_turbo; ComfyUI detects it at prefix qwen3_4b.transformer.
Z-Image decodes with the FLUX.1 autoencoder ae.safetensors (latent format Flux, 16-ch); not an SD/Qwen/Wan VAE
every Z-Image template sets ModelSamplingAuraFlow shift 3 (= ComfyUI's ZImage sampling_settings); the node default 1.73 is wrong for Z-Image
Z-Image-Turbo is CFG-free (official guidance 0; Model Zoo CFG no): cfg must be 1.0 - above 1 it burns/oversaturates and doubles the forward passes
Turbo is an 8-step model (8 NFEs); community up to 12; 30+ steps on Turbo wastes time without gains
Turbo ignores negative prompts; the official templates feed ConditioningZeroOut of the positive to 'negative'. A text negative does nothing at cfg 1 - put exclusions in the positive instead
the Z-Image base model's official cfg window is 3-5 (template 4, note 'cfg: 3~5')
the base model is not distilled: official 28-50 steps (template 25, note 'Steps: 30~50'); 8 steps is a Turbo setting

the v2.0 / v2.1 (non-8steps) Fun ControlNet unions lost Turbo's acceleration ('loss of acceleration capability and blurry images' - need more steps and cfg); on Turbo use the v1 union or a *-8steps v2.1 build at 8 steps
the alibaba-pai Fun ControlNet-Union patches are trained for Z-Image-Turbo; there is no ControlNet for the base model
alibaba-pai recommends control_context_scale 0.65-0.80 (v1) / 0.65-1.00 (v2.x); the template uses 1.0
EmptySD3LatentImage takes width/height in multiples of 16 (node step); for the control recipes the control image's size must already be a multiple of 16
official working range is 512x512 to 2048x2048 total area (base card); templates use 1024x1024
Turbo img2img refine: denoise above 0.35 'may introduce artifacts' (0.15-0.25 subtle, 0.25-0.35 creative); at higher denoise use a detailed caption as the prompt
the recipe's template needs at least this ComfyUI (all Z-Image templates are <= 0.23.0, below the pinned 0.35.0; int8 ConvRot loading on 0.35.0 is unverified)

prompting.negative_note: Turbo: no negative at all - the template wires ConditioningZeroOut(positive) into 'negative' (the model is CFG-free). Base / upscaler templates ship an empty string; the base model DOES honour a real negative ('Strongly recommended for better control').

positive.line: Long, dense natural-language descriptions; official Turbo example (verbatim): 'Young Chinese woman in red Hanfu, intricate embroidery. Impeccable makeup, red floral forehead pattern. Elaborate high bun, golden phoenix headdress, red flowers, beads. Holds round folding fan with lady, trees, bird. Neon lightning-bolt lamp, bright yellow glow, above extended left palm. Soft-lit outdoor night background, silhouetted tiered pagoda (西安大雁塔), blurred colorful distant lights.' Mixed Chinese/English in one prompt is shown officially

Bilingual text rendering is a headline feature: quote the exact string, keep each text chunk in one language, state its placement ('large white title at the top'), and add 'no additional text except the title, no random numbers or watermarks'
Structure (community consensus): shot -> subject -> appearance -> clothing -> environment -> lighting -> mood -> style -> technical notes; 80-250 words; descriptive prose beats comma tags
On Turbo embed exclusions positively ('no text, no watermark, no logos') because the negative box is ignored
The publisher's Prompt Enhancer (reasoning/world knowledge) is NOT part of any ComfyUI template; write the enriched prompt yourself

prompting.structure: shot -> subject -> appearance/clothing -> environment -> lighting -> mood/style -> text (quoted, placed) ; 80-250 words of prose

hurts.line: cfg > 1 on Turbo (burns); 30+ steps on Turbo
relying on a negative prompt on Turbo (ignored)
poetic / novel-like phrasing in long prompts; ambiguous clothing descriptions

pitfalls.cause: Turbo is CFG-free (Model Zoo CFG no, Negative Prompting no; guidance 0)
pitfalls.fix: ConditioningZeroOut of the positive as negative, cfg 1, phrase constraints positively; or switch to t2i-base for real negatives

pitfalls.symptom: burnt / oversaturated Turbo output, slow generation
pitfalls.cause: cfg above 1 on Turbo (doubles forward passes)

pitfalls.symptom: garbage conditioning / load error on the text encoder
pitfalls.cause: CLIPLoader type other than 'lumina2' for qwen_3_4b
pitfalls.fix: CLIPLoader type lumina2 (behaviour with other types: NOT FOUND, unsupported by templates)

pitfalls.symptom: weaker composition / detail than the template
pitfalls.cause: ModelSamplingAuraFlow left at its node default 1.73
pitfalls.fix: shift 3 (ComfyUI ZImage config and every template)

pitfalls.symptom: ControlNet run is blurry and needs many steps
pitfalls.cause: a v2.0 / v2.1 non-8steps Fun union on Turbo ('loss of acceleration capability and blurry images')
pitfalls.fix: v1 union or a *-2.1-*-8steps file at 8 steps; 2601/2602 builds also fix bright-spot artifacts and mask leakage

pitfalls.cause: control image over ~2500 px (the latent follows the control image via GetImageSize)
pitfalls.fix: re-enable the template's ImageScaleToMaxDimension lanczos 1024 before Canny / feed a ~1024 px map; sizes must be multiples of 16

pitfalls.symptom: a base-trained LoRA breaks Turbo's 8-step output
pitfalls.cause: LoRA trained on the non-distilled base stacked on the distilled Turbo
pitfalls.fix: stack z_image_turbo_distill_patch_lora_bf16.safetensors (Comfy-Org repo) via LoraLoaderModelOnly - purpose documented only by the community

pitfalls.symptom: int8 ConvRot / NVFP4 file fails to load
pitfalls.cause: ComfyUI too old for the quantised format (templates dated 2026-07; v0.38.1 loads them)
pitfalls.fix: use the bf16 files on the pinned 0.35.0 image unless the int8 load is verified
route edits to qwen-image or hidream; TextEncodeZImageOmni is forward-looking only
denoise 0.15-0.35; a detailed image caption as prompt

pitfalls.cause: image_z_image's subgraph is titled 'Text to Image(Z-Image-Base Int8)' but loads z_image_bf16
pitfalls.fix: the int8 template is image_z_image_int8; this profile's t2i-base loads bf16 as the template does
